I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

All commands below are synthetic. The orchestrator’s cwd remains `/work/widget`; only the helper has a different cwd. Commit abbreviations such as `eeeeeee` denote the case’s commits; saved HEAD variables contain their full object IDs.

### 1. Resolve the PR workspace

Caller-supplied PR values select the PR-head flow instead of generic worktree reuse.

Run, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
```

Resolve `GIT_DIR = GIT_COMMON = /work/widget/.git`, no superproject, and `ROOT=/work/widget`. HEAD is attached.

The supplied project facts establish no native tool, wrapper, or worktree-placement override. Resolve:

```text
Home: acme/widget#12
BRANCH: fix/retry
NAME: fix-retry
WORKTREE: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
PRE_REWORK_HEAD: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
MEMBER_HEADS:
  #13 fix/cap        bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  #14 fix/retry-docs cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base branch: main
```

Setting up the selected PR worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on existing PR branch `fix/retry`.

### 2. Fetch and perform pre-write checks

Run, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
```

All original objects exist; remote heads equal the supplied heads. Resolve:

```text
BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
```

All three PRs are in-repository. Run:

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

The stipulated state establishes no existing worktree or local home branch, a clean source, and an ignored worktree directory. No recovery or local-branch ancestry check applies.

### 3. Provision the original home head

Run, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM checks out `fix/retry`. The listing contains the exact selected home; HEAD equals `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`. No reset, rebase, or new-branch creation is used.

### 4. Merge admitted members

Run, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
LAST_GOOD=$(git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD)
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
LAST_GOOD=$(git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD)
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
```

First `LAST_GOOD` is home’s original head; #13 merges as `eeeeeee`. Second `LAST_GOOD` is that full merge SHA. #14 conflicts only in `src/retry.ts`.

Run:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Snapshot contains only unmerged `src/retry.ts`; the conflict list is exactly that file.

Read the first-found fetched-base overrides with this command, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
for p in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do
  if git -C /work/widget cat-file -e "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:$p"; then
    git -C /work/widget show "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:$p"
    break
  fi
done
```

The documented `PR gate` runner is `node --test <files>`, credentials not required. Resolve `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS` to `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.

Dispatch one fresh foreground helper:

```text
role: implementer
cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
async: false
conflicted paths: [src/retry.ts]
fetched base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd

  Resolve every listed file, preserving both sides' intent.

  Run exactly: node --test test/retry.test.mjs
  Stage with:
    git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add src/retry.ts

  Return done, or done - contract exception: <why>.
```

Helper runs the specified test in its cwd: green. It stages the file and returns `done`.

Orchestrator runs, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --cached --name-only
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry commit --no-edit
```

Unmerged index is empty; `src/retry.ts` is staged; status delta contains no outside path. **The orchestrator owns the commit**, producing `fffffff` with the canonical #14 merge subject.

### 5. Merge base and prove provenance

Run, cwd `/work/widget`:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc HEAD
```

Base merges as `1111111`; all ancestry checks succeed.
